text.title: Hot Path Baseline Template Decision Tree
text.summary: Routes on call rate, on whether the change is motivated by performance or correctness, and on the load generator's scheduling mode and sample count — to a full baseline, a reduced p50/p95 baseline, a generator fix, or skip.

decision-tree.root-question: Does the path carry at least ~1 call/min of traffic representative of production during the measurement window?

conclusion.verdict: skip; on a cold path run-to-run noise dwarfs any before/after delta the baseline could show

branch.question: Is the pending change motivated by latency or throughput, or by correctness?

conclusion.verdict: skip; baseline-then-compare is the wrong gate for a correctness fix — gate it on tests, not percentiles

branch.question: How is load produced — an open-loop generator you control, a closed-loop generator, or passive observation of production traffic?

conclusion.verdict: halt; switch the generator to constant-arrival-rate (k6 `constant-arrival-rate`, Gatling `constantUsersPerSec`, `wrk2`) before recording any tail number
apply in reduced form: publish p50/p95 with `n` and window, and mark p99 as insufficient-samples rather than reporting it
apply the full template: p50/p95/p99/max with `n`, offered load and error rate, histogram bounds, per-operation allocation and cache counters, environment pinned to a commit SHA
